notes.zh: 回答数据中心训练与推理卡的显存容量、带宽、功耗与互联口径。不回答实际训练吞吐或单位算力价格：这里记的是官方规格表数字，且带稀疏标注，实测吞吐随框架、精度与模型结构变化。
notes.en: Answers the memory capacity, bandwidth, power and interconnect figures of a data-centre training and inference card. It does not answer real training throughput or price per unit of compute: these are vendor spec-sheet numbers with sparsity, and measured throughput varies with framework, precision and model shape.
